summary: NavMap now has a versioned, portable per-repository project contract and an idempotent init command. The contract records a stable project identity, repo, workflow-manifest, or URL source, named environments, and generated artifact locations without storing credentials. Init refuses conflicting configuration and preserves unrelated .nav-map data. Open resolves initialized project artifacts while retaining explicit nav-map.json support.
deviations: Sync generation remains intentionally deferred to the next vertical slice.
remaining_blockers: The full goal still requires atomic sync orchestration and receipts, migration and identity hardening, fresh-app proof, three dogfood walkthroughs, onboarding updates, and final audit.
